summary: Figure 6 reports 404 WT hypothalamic DEGs (96 up, 308 down) at six mice per group. The registered analysis uses seven vehicle and eight cagrilintide libraries and has zero genes at BH adjusted P < 0.05. The public records do not identify the libraries used for the figure, its exact DEG rule or its gene-level results.

manualReview.summary: Figure 6 cohort, DEG rule and gene-level results require author clarification
manualReview.note: Study 3 and the GEO series identify 3 nmol/kg cagrilintide for 21 days. The treated GSMs say 0.3 nmol/kg. The paper describes bilateral MBH punches including ARC/VMN, and GEO labels these libraries ARC. Figure 6 gives six mice per group and compares each arm to WT vehicle. Its WT cagrilintide MBH bars show 404 DEGs, 96 up and 308 down. The paper reports that 117 of 138 brain samples qualified for sequencing and that CountQC later removed two ARC samples across all groups. GEO contains 116 libraries across the study. The seven WT vehicle and eight WT cagrilintide ARC deposits all enter the registered analysis. Their kallisto files contain transcript abundances and match the source pins. The current limma result on log2(gene-summed TPM + 1) has 28,705 published symbols, zero BH adjusted P < 0.05, 2,985 raw P < 0.05 (2,146 up, 839 down), and minimum published adjusted P 0.0643336618892822. The paper names the SUSHI DESeq2App. Its figure, genuine appendix and GEO deposits supply no final group manifest, figure-specific calling rule or per-gene treatment effects. Author P values, FDR, effect agreement and reference coverage remain unassessed.
reviewFlags: Taking six per arm literally would leave one of the seven deposited vehicle libraries and two of the eight treated libraries outside Figure 6. The two study-wide ARC CountQC exclusions have no published arm or sample IDs.
The 404 author calls lack an explicit statistical rule and gene identities. The generic P < 0.05 statement and thresholds for the separate module analysis cannot be assigned to this figure.
Use the publisher or Europe PMC copy of the appendix. The BioStudies file served under the same name contains an unrelated respiratory-patient table.

verificationReview.reason: The MBH bars report 404 WT cagrilintide DEGs at six mice per arm. The registered seven-vehicle/eight-treated fit has zero BH discoveries. The published group counts, unnamed regional exclusions, missing DEG rule and missing author gene table prevent a like-for-like test.
